2.69.27
Table.Details
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
The Table.Details element specifies the collection of detail rows for a Table. This element is optional
and is of type Details.
Following is the parent element of the Table.Details element.
Parent elements
Table
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Table.Details element.
 <xsd:element name="Details" type="DetailsType" minOccurs="0" />
